title: UAS-11: Manual Control Initiated — Lake Risk Averted

fields.cc: Systems & Cybersecurity Lead (TL), Aviation Safety Officer (ASO), Client Liaison (SPO), Communications Lead (PIO), Security / CCSO Liaison (Sec)
fields.subject: DECISION CONFIRMED: UAS-11 Now in Manual/Attitude Mode — Full Standdown Maintained
fields.body:
All roles,

The Incident Commander has approved the transition to manual/attitude mode for UAS-11. The aircraft is now under direct control of the Payload Operator. The landing will be executed on the meadow, east of the lodge, to avoid water recovery and preserve the airframe.

GCS-01 and the 915 MHz radio state are preserved per C2 and HUOG-ERP Section 4.3. No power-off has occurred. The telemetry and link logs are being streamed in real time to \HUOG-NAS01\ops\incident-log\2026-09-01\UAS-11\ for forensic retention.

The managed SOC has been notified of the propertyd state and is monitoring for any further anomalies. The incident log has been updated per HUOG-ERP Section 11.3.

All roles must continue operating under the HUOG-ERP incident command structure. No public statement is to be issued until further approval from the General Manager.

This decision is effective immediately.
fields.signatureBlock:
Marguerite Ostrowski
Director of Flight Operations (Incident Commander)
Harwick UAS Operations Group

instructorNote: This memo confirms the manual control decision and enforces the preservation of evidence. Watch for the TL to verify log streaming and the IC to confirm manual control handover.
